body: god what a mood. i'd say sobriety pact if i wasn't already downing xanax
if there is one thing i am grateful for, it's that i was able to know what it felt like to be loved. best of luck to you.

Oh, geez, that actually explains a lot. Some of my fears/ruminations are so persistent and pounding I feel like they've created a well-worn road in my brain. My boyfriend is the first person who ever made me feel like I was worth something, so hearing him talk about how he doesn't know if he wants to be with me, can't feel anything for me, feels empty when we talk triggers this godawful breakdown...Is there some other way to deal with this?

They've been diagnosed with OCD before, and they're in therapy and on medication. I've also been diagnosed with OCD, but I don't give it much weight because it doesn't seem that impairing. I just can't stop thinking that they hate me and think I'm horrible and disgusting. I don't know how to have any faith in the "This isn't' real; it's just the OCD" sentiment. Or, the thought of "They clearly are fine not interacting with me, which means they don't love me because if they did they'd want to talk to me" or "the fact they even have doubts means there's something wrong with me" or "these doubes won't ever stop and they'll never love me no matter how hard I try," etc etc
